$comment: Configs and other files modules can bring. Each entry says where it comes from and where it goes: `install` (a command), `copy` (a file or folder in library/, copied whole) or `template` (a file in template/, which Copier renders and merges with the project's edits), and `output` (the path, or paths, it writes in the project). An install runs when one of its outputs is missing; outputs go when no module needs the entry any more. An entry with no source is written by another entry's `install` (its output is in that entry's `output`). `frameworks` (if any) lists the frameworks it fits; elsewhere it is left out. A copied file has {port}, {css} and {srcDirs} replaced.

AGENTS.md.describe: tells Claude to read the Next.js docs bundled in node_modules first; `next dev` writes the same block.
